undeclared.decision: Every task release includes all project-wide claims, evidence, and decisions records, without filtering or binding them to the selected task.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A release can contain unrelated tasks' information, and changes to unrelated project records change the release core for an otherwise frozen task. The assumptions do not declare this scope.

undeclared.decision: Resume uses the current checkout's skill instructions, rather than instructions pinned when the task was planned or checkpointed.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Editing or updating a skill changes the action ID and execution instructions without changing the task revision. Completed task snapshots do not preserve which instruction version produced their artifacts.

undeclared.decision: Research integrity is mandatory even when the caller explicitly requests a different skill subset.
undeclared.why_it_matters: An explicit citation-only or explorable-only request gains an additional required step. A-008 declares broad-goal ordering, but not this override of explicit selection.

stale_rows: A-006 and docs/VALIDATION.md:75 say planning records local source paths; normalize_sources stores only candidate.name, losing the actual locator.
A-010 presents the installed console as an optional usable entry point, but the built wheel contains no skill instructions and installed resume fails.
athena/cli.py:51 says repeated --skill arguments set an ordered chain, while routing canonicalizes their order and adds the mandatory integrity step.

defects.issue: Checkpoint checks only an existing destination leaf, not its ancestors. Reproduced with a real Windows junction at .athena/artifacts/<task_id>: checkpoint succeeded, marked the task complete, and created the artifact outside the project. Task-directory reads and writes also lack equivalent ancestor checks.
defects.fix: Apply no-link/reparse-point and containment checks to every state/artifact destination and existing ancestor before mutation, including task files and lock paths. Add real junction regression tests and account for check-to-use replacement races.

defects.issue: A live writer's lock is stolen solely because its file modification time exceeds 60 seconds. Reproduced by aging an actively held lock and acquiring a second writer token inside the first critical section. Large checkpoint copies or release exports can naturally exceed this duration, permitting overlapping writes and lost revisions.
defects.fix: Do not expire an active lock based only on age. Prefer an operating-system lock released on process termination, or a robust ownership/liveness protocol. Test a long-running owner against a second writer.

defects.issue: The distribution packages only athena, but resume requires a sibling skills/<skill>/SKILL.md tree. Built and installed the wheel in an isolated temporary directory: it contained zero SKILL.md files, and init/plan succeeded but resume raised BlockedError for unavailable instructions.
defects.fix: Package the required skill resources and resolve them through package resources, or explicitly support a validated external catalog location. Add a wheel-build/install/resume smoke test outside the repository checkout.

defects.issue: load_task validates the document's schema and project membership but never checks that its embedded task_id matches the requested ID and filename. Reproduced by placing task B's valid JSON under task A's filename: load_task(A) silently returned B. Subsequent operations can act on the wrong task and persist contradictory identities.
defects.fix: Reject task documents whose task_id differs from the requested identifier, and test swapped or renamed task-state files across status, resume, checkpoint, and export.

defects.issue: Research records are checked only for UTF-8 and secret patterns, not JSONL validity. Reproduced with claims.jsonl containing 'not JSON at all\n': export succeeded and verify returned verified=true, despite the stated corrupt-state rejection and JSONL contract.
defects.fix: Strictly parse every nonempty record line during export and verification, rejecting malformed JSON, duplicate keys, and non-finite values; define and enforce the supported record shape.

defects.issue: Local source locators are reduced to basenames. A source outside the project cannot be found from the resumed action, and different directories containing the same filename become indistinguishable as locations. This contradicts the recorded-path contract.
defects.fix: Persist a usable private source locator or an explicit source-binding mechanism. Keep private paths out of releases through deliberate redaction, rather than discarding the locator needed for execution.
